threat_event: Associate portal accounts taken over at scale (credential stuffing or SIM swap) and direct deposits changed before Friday payroll
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Associates sign in with SMS one-time codes; associate-entered bank changes take effect next payroll with only an email notice; 41 fraudulent changes in 2026 H1 ($38,200)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 associate portal and app; SYS-02 payroll; BP-01
existing_controls: Lockout after 5 failed attempts; email notice of bank change; associates reimbursed after fraud
treatment_plan: App-based codes or passkeys for associates; 1-payroll hold or verified call-back for new bank accounts; alert on bank changes from new devices; pay card fallback for disputed changes
exposure_estimate_usd: $150K-$600K per payday event (diverted pay reimbursed, investigation, associate attrition)

threat_event: Payroll specialist account taken over through an adversary-in-the-middle phishing kit that relays the push approval; attacker exports the associate register and changes direct deposits
threat_source: Cybercriminal group (payroll fraud and identity theft)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Push MFA can be relayed; no alert on register exports or bank-change spikes; payroll audit reports kept 180 days and not reviewed
existing_controls: SSO with number-matching push MFA; managed-device conditional access; call-back on staff-entered bank changes
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant authenticators for payroll staff and administrators; payroll export and bank-change alerts in the SIEM; payroll fraud training (P08 runbook 1)
exposure_estimate_usd: $1.5M-$4M (notice to up to 168,000 people, counsel, forensics, credit monitoring, diverted pay)

threat_event: Bulk theft of SSNs and bank accounts from the data warehouse or from extracts saved in file shares
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Full SSNs and bank accounts copied nightly for reports that need neither; 46 users can query; no query logging; extracts land in file shares
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 data warehouse; SYS-05 file shares
existing_controls: SSO with MFA; encryption at rest with a company-managed key
treatment_plan: Load only the last 4 digits; restrict access to 6 named analysts with masked views; query logging to the SIEM; purge old extracts from file shares

threat_event: Ransomware with data theft encrypts laptops, file shares, and cloud workloads, halting dispatch and the integration platform before payroll
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Kiosks on staff networks at 9 branches; standing SaaS administrator rights; integration platform and archive never restore-tested; warehouse holds full SSNs
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04; SYS-05; SYS-13; SYS-14; BP-01 to BP-06
sp800_53_controls: CP-9; CP-10; CP-4; SC-7; AC-6; SI-4
existing_controls: EDR with 24x7 MSSP; write-once backups in a separate account; MFA for all staff
treatment_plan: Kiosk segmentation at Branches 6-14; restore tests of the integration platform and archive; separate backup administrators; ransomware tabletop

threat_event: Payroll platform unavailable on payroll day (ransomware or outage at the payroll vendor) delays pay for about 3,600 associates
threat_source: Service provider failure or cyberattack on the vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single payroll vendor; no written or tested off-cycle manual payroll; funding depends on the vendor releasing files
regulatory_driver: N56-BM (RC.RP-01); 29 CFR 778.106 (overtime on the regular payday)
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 (RTO 8 hours, RPO 1 hour); pay cards for 9% of associates
treatment_plan: Off-cycle manual payroll procedure from the prior register with a tested pay card and ACH path through the bank; payroll outage tabletop (P08 runbook 2)
exposure_estimate_usd: $300K-$1M (missed payday, attrition, emergency funding, wage claims)

threat_event: ATS users open I-9 document images and consumer reports of people they do not work with
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 262 users in recruiter, branch manager, and account manager roles can open I-9 images and consumer reports for all branches; ATS roles never reviewed
existing_controls: Named ATS accounts; ATS access history
treatment_plan: Restrict I-9 images and consumer reports to 29 onboarding and compliance staff and the hiring branch manager; quarterly ATS role review

threat_event: Clinician medical information (immunizations, TB tests, physicals, drug screens) viewed by recruiters or shared with clients beyond what they need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Medical documents stored with general credential files; visible to all 30 Healthcare recruiters; client portal shares full physical exam forms
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-10 credentialing platform and client portal
existing_controls: Credentialing role for specialists; client agreements
treatment_plan: Separate medical document category limited to credentialing specialists; clearance-only view for clients and recruiters; authorization form scoped to what each client needs

threat_event: Finger templates of about 1,300 associates exposed in a timekeeping vendor breach, or collected without notice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Clocks deployed without written notice and consent, a template retention schedule, or breach notice terms
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-06 fingerprint clocks and vendor cloud
existing_controls: Vendor-hosted; templates encrypted per vendor documentation
treatment_plan: Written notice and consent at enrollment; delete templates 30 days after assignment end; breach notice and security terms at renewal; alternative badge clock for associates who decline

threat_event: On-site coordinator or payroll specialist creates a ghost associate or edits time to collect pay
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: On-site coordinators can enter manual punches; payroll specialists can add associates and change rates without a second review
existing_controls: Client supervisors approve time; Controller approves the payroll register
treatment_plan: Second review of manual punches and new associates without an E-Verify case; monthly analytics on duplicate bank accounts and addresses

threat_event: Former staff keep E-Verify access, or credentials are shared, so verification actions cannot be attributed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 22 E-Verify accounts outside SSO; not on the termination checklist; 3 accounts of departed staff active at P07 testing
regulatory_driver: E-Verify MOU Art. II.A.3; Art. II.A.15
existing_controls: HR emails the compliance team at termination
treatment_plan: Deactivate the 3 accounts; E-Verify on the termination checklist; monthly reconciliation to the HR roster; credential-sharing attestation
exposure_estimate_usd: $25K-$100K (MOU compliance action, loss of the remote I-9 option)

threat_event: ICE inspection finds the electronic Form I-9 system does not meet the documentation, quality assurance, and audit trail standards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written system description or procedures; no periodic checks; archive has no audit trail
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 I-9 module; SYS-04 document archive
existing_controls: ATS module keeps per-form change history
treatment_plan: Electronic I-9 system description and procedure; quarterly sample check of 50 I-9s; archive object logging and versioning

threat_event: Forms I-9 cannot be produced within 3 business days of an inspection notice because the archive or ATS data is lost
threat_source: Hardware or service failure; vendor exit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Archive replicated but not backed up; ATS contract has no data-return clause; never tried a full production
existing_controls: Vendor-hosted ATS; cross-region replication
treatment_plan: Archive in the backup plan with write-once retention; quarterly I-9 export; data-return clause at ATS renewal; annual mock inspection

threat_event: Candidate rejected on the basis of a consumer report without the pre-adverse action copy and summary of rights
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recruiters can set Not Eligible in the ATS without triggering the provider's pre-adverse workflow
existing_controls: Provider sends letters when triggered; standalone disclosure since 2024
treatment_plan: Lock the Not Eligible status to compliance roles; monthly reconciliation of rejections to letters

threat_event: Records kept since 2012 (consumer reports, I-9s, credential files, recordings) widen any breach and fail disposal duties
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No enforced retention schedule; nothing purged
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Retention schedule in POL-04; first purge of records past retention by 2027-01-31; certified device disposal
exposure_estimate_usd: Raises breach costs by an estimated 3 to 4 times

threat_event: AI ranking auto-advances Light Industrial applicants in a way that disadvantages a protected group
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Auto-advance on since 2025-09-15 without bias testing, notice, or human review of lower-ranked applicants; 85% of Light Industrial placements in 2026 H1 came from the auto-advanced list
existing_controls: Recruiters can see every applicant list
treatment_plan: Switch to sort-only mode; bias testing and quarterly monitoring; candidate notice and accommodation path (P10)

threat_event: Recruiting text assistant's knockout questions screen out applicants with disabilities or limited English, with no accommodation path
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Knockout questions on lifting, shifts, and transportation reject automatically; text-only; no alternative channel stated
existing_controls: Branches accept walk-in applications
treatment_plan: Knockouts route to a recruiter instead of rejecting; accommodation and phone option in every conversation; Spanish-language flow (P10)

threat_event: AI vendors reuse candidate data to train models or suffer a breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Marketplace click-through terms; no data use, retention, or breach terms; no security review
existing_controls: ATS marketplace listing
treatment_plan: Data use and security addendum with a no-training clause, 30-day deletion, and 72-hour breach notice

threat_event: Staff paste candidate or associate data into public generative AI tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public chatbots reachable from laptops; the approved enterprise assistant is a 60-user pilot
existing_controls: POL-05 rule; enterprise assistant pilot
treatment_plan: Block unapproved AI sites on managed laptops; expand the enterprise assistant with data protection terms (P10)

threat_event: Lobby kiosk used to install a keylogger or reach staff systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Kiosks on the staff network at 9 branches; USB storage allowed; shared local account
existing_controls: EDR on kiosks; kiosks in view of the front desk
treatment_plan: Kiosk segment at Branches 6-14; kiosk browser mode with session reset; USB storage blocked

threat_event: Business email compromise sends a client false remittance instructions or slips a fake supplier invoice into an MSP consolidated invoice
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Account managers and MSP staff receive payment-change requests by email; supplier bank changes in the VMS are not called back
existing_controls: External sender tags; impersonation protection
treatment_plan: Call-back on any remittance or supplier bank change; invoice fraud training for billing and MSP staff

threat_event: Attacker activity in the ATS, payroll platform, VMS, or credentialing platform goes unnoticed for weeks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SaaS audit logs not sent to the SIEM; no alert rules for exports, bank changes, or bulk downloads
existing_controls: Audit logs exist in each SaaS
treatment_plan: SaaS log connectors to the SIEM; MSSP alert rules for payroll exports, bank-change spikes, and bulk document downloads
exposure_estimate_usd: Raises R-002 and R-003 costs by delaying containment

threat_event: Breach notice deadlines missed (Florida 30 days, other states, MSP clients 48 hours, DHS immediately)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notice duties first written in 2026; no decision log; no residence-state report
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(3)-(5); E-Verify MOU Art. II.A.16; MSP client contracts
existing_controls: P08 notification matrix (approved 2026-09-22)
treatment_plan: Decision log, notice templates, residence-state report, and tabletop exercises

threat_event: ATS vendor outage lasts beyond the 8-hour dispatch RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor RTO 12 hours; dispatch depends on the daily assignment export
existing_controls: Daily assignment export
treatment_plan: Twice-daily export; recovery terms at the 2027 ATS renewal; branch phone-dispatch drill

threat_event: Credentialing platform outage stops Healthcare shift starts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No stated RTO; daily credential status export missing on 2 of 5 sampled days
existing_controls: Daily export (inconsistent)
treatment_plan: Automated daily export with failure alert; vendor recovery commitment or replacement at renewal

threat_event: Hurricane closes HQ and several branches for days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payroll, credentialing, and the contact center are all at HQ; contingency plan not approved
existing_controls: SaaS reachable from anywhere; laptops; dual ISP at HQ
treatment_plan: Contingency plan with remote payroll and credentialing runs; contact center failover to remote agents

threat_event: Integration platform or document archive cannot be restored within its RTO after a failure or attack
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integration platform never restore-tested; archive replicated, not backed up
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 integration platform and document archive; BP-02; BP-03; BP-10
existing_controls: Infrastructure templates; replication
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore tests; archive added to the backup plan with write-once retention

threat_event: Integration error creates wrong pay rates, drops new hires from payroll, or double-bills MSP time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No reconciliation reports; VMS time imports not checked for duplicates
existing_controls: Payroll specialists spot-check large changes
treatment_plan: Duplicate checks on VMS imports; weekly reconciliation of new hires, rate changes, and billed hours

threat_event: Timekeeping vendor exposes associates' clock-in geolocation history
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Location history kept for the life of the account
existing_controls: Vendor-hosted
treatment_plan: 13-month location retention setting; breach terms at renewal

threat_event: Screening provider breach exposes consumer reports, drug test results, and SSNs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Annual review of the provider's SOC 2 not yet done
existing_controls: Security terms and 72-hour breach notice in the 2024 agreement
treatment_plan: Annual SOC 2 review (P09 Part B)

threat_event: Credentialing vendor breach exposes clinicians' medical records and licenses
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor has no SOC 2 report; no breach notice term; client users without MFA
existing_controls: Confidentiality clause
treatment_plan: Security questionnaire and a SOC 2 commitment by renewal; breach notice term; MFA for client users

threat_event: VMS vendor or MSP program breach exposes client cost centers, supplier rates, and worker data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firm users have local accounts outside SSO; departed users found in P07
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2; app-based MFA
treatment_plan: Federate VMS to SSO; quarterly user review; contract notice terms aligned to the 48-hour client duty

threat_event: SOC 2 Type 2 report is not ready by the MSP renewals, and a client moves its program
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Control gaps in access reviews, logging, change control, and recovery; observation period cannot start until fixed
existing_controls: Readiness assessment (P09)
treatment_plan: Remediate in 2026 Q4 to 2027 Q1; Type 1 at 2027-03-31; Type 2 observation 2027-04-01 to 2027-09-30
exposure_estimate_usd: About $2M a year of fee and payrolling revenue at risk

threat_event: Impostor uses a stolen identity and manipulated video to pass a remote Form I-9 examination
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote alternative procedure used for Office and Professional hires; no written checklist or liveness checks
regulatory_driver: N56-R03 (8 CFR 274a.2(b)(1)(ix)); E-Verify MOU Art. II.A.6
existing_controls: E-Verify photo matching for List A documents
treatment_plan: Remote examination checklist; in-person examination when in doubt

threat_event: Outbound recruiting calls recorded without all-party consent; recordings with spoken SSNs kept indefinitely
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No announcement on outbound softphone calls; about 1.1 million recordings since 2022
existing_controls: Inbound IVR plays a recording notice
treatment_plan: Recording announcement on every outbound call; SSN capture moved to the IVR keypad with recording paused; 18-month recording retention

threat_event: Cloud or SaaS administrator account taken over and used to disable defenses or export data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ATS and payroll administrators have standing rights on everyday accounts; push MFA can be relayed
existing_controls: Just-in-time elevation in the cloud; push MFA
treatment_plan: Separate administrator accounts for SaaS; phishing-resistant keys for administrators

threat_event: Known-exploited vulnerability in an SD-WAN edge or remote access component is exploited before the next scan cycle
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Quarterly scans; 9 of 41 critical findings in 2026 H1 exceeded the 30-day target
existing_controls: MSSP weekly known exploited vulnerability review
treatment_plan: Monthly scans; 14-day remediation for internet-facing critical findings

threat_event: Document archive or warehouse exposed to the internet by misconfiguration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many storage settings changed by hand
existing_controls: Guardrails deny public storage in every account
treatment_plan: Accepted by the IT Director: guardrails cannot be disabled from workload accounts

threat_event: Backups deleted or encrypted along with production
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup administrators also administer workloads
existing_controls: 30-day write-once retention in a separate account and region
treatment_plan: Separate backup administrator roles and break-glass access

threat_event: Lost or stolen laptop exposes cached files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops leave offices daily
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted by the IT Director: encryption takes the data outside the statute's personal information definition

threat_event: Lost company smartphone exposes candidate texts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Smartphones hold recruiter text threads
existing_controls: Device management with passcode and remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted by the IT Director: residual risk Low

threat_event: Denial of service against the career site
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Career site is vendor-hosted
existing_controls: Vendor denial-of-service protection; phone and walk-in applications
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Director of Recruiting Operations: residual risk Low

threat_event: MSSP misses or delays escalation because key systems do not send logs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SaaS logs absent; 2 of 40 high-severity escalations late in the MSSP SOC 2 report
existing_controls: 24x7 MSSP with 30-minute escalation term
treatment_plan: SaaS log onboarding; monthly service review with escalation metrics

threat_event: Compromise of the ATS or payroll vendor reaches firm data (supply chain)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendors hold every SSN and bank account; vendor SOC 2 reports not reviewed against complementary controls
existing_controls: SOC 2 Type 2 reports on file; contract breach terms
treatment_plan: Annual SOC 2 and complementary control review; vendor incident runbook steps (P08)

threat_event: Florida Attorney General action after a breach because security measures were not reasonable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Program defined but key gaps (portal sign-in, warehouse SSNs, SaaS monitoring) open
existing_controls: 2026 risk assessment, policies, and assessment
treatment_plan: Close the High risks on schedule; keep evidence of the program

threat_event: Former staff or client users keep VMS, credentialing client portal, or client portal accounts
threat_source: Former workforce member or client user
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Local accounts outside SSO; client users never reviewed; 4 VMS accounts of departed staff at P07 testing
existing_controls: Manual removal by program staff
treatment_plan: VMS on SSO; quarterly review of client users with each client's contact; 90-day inactivity disable

threat_event: Unapproved change to ATS workflows, payroll settings, or AI tool settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No change control for SaaS configuration (the AI auto-advance setting was enabled without review)
existing_controls: Infrastructure change tickets
treatment_plan: Change log with approval for payroll, I-9, credentialing, and AI settings; quarterly configuration export compared with baseline

threat_event: Departing recruiter exports candidate and client lists to a competitor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recruiters can export search results; no data loss alerts
existing_controls: Non-solicitation agreements
treatment_plan: Limit exports to managers; alert on large exports; access removed at resignation notice

threat_event: A PE add-on acquisition of a smaller staffing firm connects unknown systems and data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security due diligence checklist
existing_controls: Integration handled by IT ad hoc
treatment_plan: Security due diligence checklist and 90-day integration plan for any acquisition

threat_event: Clinician drug test results or credential file emailed to the wrong client
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Files sometimes sent by email instead of the client portal
existing_controls: Client portal available
treatment_plan: Portal-only delivery; outbound email data loss rule for medical keywords

threat_event: A placed clinician's privacy violation at a hospital client ends the client relationship
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Clinicians use hospital systems under hospital control; training before first shift is tracked by hand
existing_controls: HIPAA training required before the first shift
treatment_plan: Training completion as a credential item that blocks scheduling

threat_event: Client site badges and hospital system credentials not returned at assignment end
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Badge log on spreadsheets; returns not checked
existing_controls: Safety and Risk Manager issues badges
treatment_plan: Badge return in the assignment-end checklist; monthly reconciliation with each client

threat_event: Exposed payroll API key used to change associate bank accounts or export payroll data through the integration interface
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Key with write access to bank-account fields stored in plain text in the container image and code repository; unrotated since 2024; readable by 11 accounts including 3 contractor developers (found in P07 testing 2026-08-26)
existing_controls: Repository access limited to named accounts
treatment_plan: Rotate the key; store in the secrets service; split keys by job; secret scanning; contractor access on managed devices only
